messages.subject: Webinar: Commercial contracts update 2026 - liability & AI clauses
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Subscriber,

Join our 90-minute CPD webinar on 12 May covering recent developments in commercial contracting, including limitation of liability post-Pinewood, AI service clauses, and indexation in long-term agreements. 1.5 CPD hours. Members £45.

Register online. Unsubscribe at any time.
